T3_about.h2: What are Bio-Rad immunoassay quality controls?
T3_about.text: Immunoassay Quality Controls are Bio-Rad independent control materials for monitoring immunoassay precision. The range covers controls for therapeutic drug monitoring, infectious disease, tumor markers, and other specialty testing. The item list includes InteliQ and Liquichek products, including Specialty Immunoassay, Tumor Marker, and Specialty Immunoassay Plus Control. Product- and lot-specific details determine the available levels and stability.

items.text: According to the manufacturer, the materials are intended to monitor the precision of applicable methods. Laboratories can select controls for routine or specialty immunoassays, including tumor marker and infectious disease testing.

items.q: What are Immunoassay Quality Controls used for?
items.a: They are used to monitor precision in routine and specialty immunoassays. Specific characteristics depend on the product and lot.
The list includes InteliQ Specialty Immunoassay and Tumor Marker Control, plus Liquichek Specialty Immunoassay Plus Control.

items.q: Which Specialty Immunoassay Control (InteliQ) levels are listed?
items.a: The list includes Level LTA and Levels 1, 2, and 3.

items.q: Who supplies Bio-Rad controls in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is a Bio-Rad partner and supplier in Ukraine.
